name: Morisawa Chiaki
source:
Chiaki is an idol who dreams and lives like a hero. He leads RYUSEITAI M now. He is straightforward, passionate, and always strives to achieve the best. Chiaki cherishes his friends a lot. His singing voice is powerful and cheering, and his performances are also bristling with power.

Chiaki is the RYUSEI Red, the leader of RYUSEITAI at STARMAKER PRODUCTION.

[From in-game profile]
